messages:
Priya: Heads up team, starting change window in 10m for release rel_2026_03_21_02. Plan: canary 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Pin model v2.4.0 for inference and enable the new batching config. I'll post the rollout link once live.

deploy-bot: Initiating rollout rel_2026_03_21_02, step=canary, targets=global, traffic=20%. Link: https://deploys.internal/release/rel_2026_03_21_02 :rocket:

Luca: I'll monitor SLO dashboards (p50/p95/p99), 5xx, 429s, and sentry error count. Thresholds: p95 > 300ms OR 5xx > 0.5% OR Sentry error-count delta > 30/min => pause.

Grafana-bot: Snapshot: p95=115ms, p99=420ms, 5xx=0.12%, 429=0.02%. Dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/d/rollout/rel_2026_03_21_02

Priya: Running synthetic smoke loop from three regions. If we see 429 spikes on /v1/generate, switch embeddings to fallback.

Platform-oncall: Copy. Enabling alertgroup `deploy-watchlist` and annotating runbook with rollout id.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 20%. No alerts in first 2m. Proceeding to 50% in 2m unless paused.

Luca: Noted a subtle rise in p99 tail to ~560ms but p95 steady. Correlating traces now.

Grafana-bot: Alert: Sentry new issue rate up +38 in last 3m for service=inference-encoder (level=error). :warning:

Priya: Seeing error stack: `TimeoutError: worker marshall exceeded 2s` from encoder pool. This could be related to batching change.

Luca: Initiating quick mitigation: reduce batch_max from 128 -> 48 on v2.4.0 canary and enable per-route rate limit for embeddings (100rps).

Platform-oncall: Applying config: `deployctl update rel_2026_03_21_02 --set batch_max=48 --set embeddings.rate_limit=100`

deploy-bot: Canary config update applied. Re-evaluating metrics.

Grafana-bot: SLOs: p95 returned to 130ms, p99 down to 420ms, Sentry new issues slowed. 5xx stable at 0.15%.

Priya: Good. Hold at 50% for 8m observation window before final ramp. Also tagging release notes: note "embedding marshalling tuning" and the temporary rate-limit.

Luca: Small 429 blip on us-west for /v1/generate at t+9m (0.6% for 30s) — looks like transient overload on one shard. Routing fallbacks kicked in and rate limiting helped.

Platform-oncall: I triggered a partial pin for embeddings: `route.pin embeddings us-east-legacy 60%` to reduce pressure on the new pool. Confirmed.

Priya: Confirmed traffic pin applied. Also created a short lived alert suppression for noise: `suppress deploy-watchlist for 10m` to avoid alert fatigue while we stabilize.

Grafana-bot: 10m observation window complete. Metrics stable: p95=118ms, 5xx=0.09%, sentry excess=+2. No further action needed.

deploy-bot: Proceeding to 100% traffic. Rollout complete: rel_2026_03_21_02 now at 100% on v2.4.0. :tada:

Priya: Adding release notes: https://docs.internal/releases/rel_2026_03_21_02 - includes note about embedding batch tuning and the temporary rate-limit/routing pin. Will follow up with a short incident blurb in the weekly deploy notes.

Luca: I'll draft a short post-deploy blip note: root cause likely a combination of larger default batch and a single shard memory pressure; action items: shard balancing, tighter batch defaults, and better synthetic coverage for embedding heavy flows.

Platform-oncall: Closing the annotated runbook for rel_2026_03_21_02. If anyone needs logs or a trace dump ping me.

Priya: Thanks all — smooth run despite the transient. Good follow-through on the Sentry alert.

Luca: Nice coordination. Moving these follow-ups to the release checklist.

Grafana-bot: Archived snapshot for rel_2026_03_21_02.
